title: Two Separate Overlays Have Size Issues
text:
Two Separate Overlays Have Size Issues. I ordered 2 queen size latex overlays. At 2 separate places at Amazon, seller listed that the overlays are 60 inches x 80 inches. Both of the overlays are not 60 x 80. At their widest, they are 2 inches wider, at 62 inches. At their longest, they are 2 inches shorter, at 78 inches. You can imagine having 2 extra inches of overhang on the width is not acceptable.

Seller wrote and said these "may have different dimensions" than what was listed at Amazon. I was shocked at this, as nowhere at Amazon did they say this fact, but instead says 80 x 60 twice, and because bedding can be and should be cut to exact size to fit properly, of course.
